parameters.query: SELECT value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key = 'PROBABILITY_MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE';

-- Wahrscheinlichkeitskalibrierung aus trading.simulation_trades.
-- FIX 2026-08-28:
--  (a) p_target_before_stop erkannte nur 'target_reached' - die Simulation schreibt aber
--      'take_profit' (checkExit in WF17). Vokabular jetzt beidseitig akzeptiert -> p_target
--      war vorher systematisch 0.
--  (b) Zusaetzlich zu den regime-spezifischen Segmenten ein regime-agnostisches Rollup je
--      strategy x direction (segment_market_regime = NULL). Der Konsument (Trading-
--      Entscheidungszentrale, LATERAL) faellt darauf zurueck, wenn die Empfehlung kein
--      passendes / nur 'unknown' Regime hat - sonst bleibt die Kalibrierung praktisch
--      immer ungematcht.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT st.strategy,
    CASE st.direction WHEN 'long' THEN 'kauf' WHEN 'short' THEN 'verkauf' ELSE st.direction END AS direction,
    st.market_regime_at_entry AS regime,
    st.net_pnl, st.exit_reason, st.realized_r_multiple
  FROM trading.simulation_trades st
  JOIN trading.backtest_runs br ON br.id = st.simulation_run_id
  WHERE st.status = 'closed'
    AND (br.data_category IS NULL OR br.data_category <> 'out_of_sample')
)
SELECT strategy, direction, regime AS market_regime_at_entry,
  count(*)::int AS sample_size,
  avg((net_pnl > 0)::int)::numeric(6,4) AS p_win,
  (avg((exit_reason IN ('take_profit','target_reached'))::int)
     FILTER (WHERE exit_reason IN ('take_profit','target_reached','stop_loss')))::numeric(6,4) AS p_target_before_stop,
  avg(realized_r_multiple)::numeric(10,4) AS expected_value_r
FROM base
WHERE regime IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strategy, direction, regime
UNION ALL
SELECT strategy, direction, NULL::text AS market_regime_at_entry,
  count(*)::int AS sample_size,
  avg((net_pnl > 0)::int)::numeric(6,4) AS p_win,
  (avg((exit_reason IN ('take_profit','target_reached'))::int)
     FILTER (WHERE exit_reason IN ('take_profit','target_reached','stop_loss')))::numeric(6,4) AS p_target_before_stop,
  avg(realized_r_multiple)::numeric(10,4) AS expected_value_r
FROM base
GROUP BY strategy, direction;
